```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(longpower)

alpha <- 0.05            
power_target <- 0.80     
delta <- 0.6             
sigma2 <- 1              
nt <- 4                 
rho <- 0.5               
loss_rate <- 0.2         


R <- matrix(rho, nrow = nt, ncol = nt)  
diag(R) <- 1                             

retention <- rep(1 - loss_rate, nt)  

result <- power.mmrm(
    Ra = R,
    sigmaa = sqrt(sigma2),
    delta = delta,
    power = power_target,
    sig.level = alpha,
    ra = retention,
    alternative = "two.sided"
)

print(result)
```
